label: Remove customers
description: Domain graph behind DELETE /customers. It takes the list of ids itself: one removal per id, eight at a time and never more than a hundred in all, and the graph answers only when every one of them has settled. A missing customer refuses the whole batch; the list answered keeps the order asked.

nodes.label: Remove each customer
nodes.description: customer.remove once per id, eight at a time; the element is the id itself
